exposure: Occurrence of a third maternal delay
Poor birth preparedness and complication readiness (BPCR) plan
cohort: 484 neonates admitted to public hospitals in Hadiya zone, southern Ethiopia
finding: Short birth interval, lack of ANC, Caesarean mode of delivery, occurrence of a third maternal delay, and poor BPCR plan were identified as significant determinants of NNM.
mod_finding: Caesarean mode of delivery was identified as a significant determinant of NNM.
gest_age: Less than 33 weeks (for 44.6% of near-miss cases)
